notes.title: Moose at the SGA 2023
notes.notes:
Moose Lost in the Woods has won two awards at the Swedish Game Awards 2023! The game won Best Narrative 2023 and Gamer's Choice 2023 and was also nominated for Best Art 2023, Best Design 2023, and Game of the Year 2023!

Thank you all so much for playing Moose Lost in The Woods, the feedback has honestly blown us all away and we're beyond grateful!

The moose is loose!
Spång Studios
